title: Appeals and Grievances Schedule Note: Cost-Share Percentage on a Late-Filed TRICARE Select Line
content:
**Appeals and Grievances — cost-share percentage schedule note for the line opening a case**

For a Claim Factual Reconsideration opened on a TRICARE Select claim line that was denied because the claim reached the region after the claim filing deadline:

The cost-share percentage on the line opening a case follows the provider's network status recorded on it and the schedule of the tier the line opening a case was billed under: from a non-network provider it is that tier's non-network outpatient percentage; a network line for preventive care carries none; any other network line carries that tier's network outpatient percentage, which is none on a tier that charges fixed network copayments.

The tier is the TRICARE Select tier of the enrollment the line was billed under, and the percentages are that tier's figures in the TRICARE Select schedule. "Non-network" covers a provider recorded on the line as non-network, participating or nonparticipating; "network" is a provider recorded on the line as network.

| Network status recorded on the line | Service class | Cost-share percentage |
|---|---|---|
| non-network (participating or nonparticipating) | any | the tier's non-network outpatient percentage |
| network | preventive care | none (0) |
| network | any other class | the tier's network outpatient percentage (none on a tier that charges fixed network copayments) |

*Hypothetical reading.* Under a tier whose schedule shows a network outpatient percentage of 20 and a non-network outpatient percentage of 25 (illustrative figures only): a non-network nonparticipating specialty line carries 25 percent; a network preventive care line carries 0; a network primary care line carries 20 percent. Under a tier that charges fixed network copayments, the network outpatient percentage is none, so a network line carries no percentage.
